items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: his brother Hank Jones playing piano, they were all on staff, CBS staff man.

ctx.x: So he said, “You’ve got to get a tux.” You know. I had to get a tux and the band, on The Ed Sullivan Show, it was Thad Jones in the trumpet section, his brother Hank Jones playing piano, they were all on staff, CBS staff man. Those guys were like busy in the studios, and a lot of other guys. Great, great players. But after I went with Bobby he asked me to stay with him you know. I did the first gig and he said, “No, you want to stay?” I said okay. I stayed there for four years. I did it for four years with him. ©…
Do you mind me asking what was your weekly salary when you started with him?
